annotations.text:
Boxscore on app-kit. Matched: Tokyo Day/Night tokens, JetBrains Mono 13.5px, console's 48px header + 40px page row, 68px rail, 6px radii, Mantine table spacing.
Each artboard has a Dark tweak. Metric values are sample data; the roster is the live acme-web one plus boxscore's two extras.

Settings: sections mirror the scopes in the spec (team, user, read-only suite values). Roster is the featured composite because it is the shared key.
Edits go through settings-kit; team values are local until committed and pushed, so the section header says so.
